subject: 🏃 Tuesday — 6×1000m Track VO2 Intervals (Wk 4)
html:
Tomorrow: 6×1000m at 6:50–7:00/mi (VO2 pace), 90-second jog recovery between reps. This is the last quality session before Saturday's PAL 10K — the goal is to sharpen, not fatigue. Structure: 1.9 mi easy jog to the high school track, 6×1000m with 90s recovery jog, 1.9 mi easy jog home. ~8 mi total.

Pre-run activation (5 min): Quadruped hip CARs (3 each direction, each leg), banded lateral walks (10 each direction), glute bridges (10 reps), plus PT-prescribed quadruped banded hip IR (5–10 reps each side). Do these before you leave the house.

Pacing discipline: Hit 6:50–7:00 on the reps — don't chase sub-6:50. Your Week 2 session (6×800m) landed every rep at 6:40–7:00 with a 6:40 finisher, all at HR ≤167. Today's reps are 25% longer at the same pace band, so expect HR to climb slightly higher per rep. That's fine — these are short enough that pace is the anchor, not HR. Negative-split the set if you can: open at 7:00 and let the last rep rip toward 6:50.

Focus cue: Relaxed hands and shoulders through every rep. When the 1000m reps start to bite at 600m, the tension creeps into the upper body first. Drop the shoulders, unclench the fists, and let the legs do the work.

Context: Week 4 of 12, Phase 1 Foundation — PAL 10K benchmark taper week. You're 4 days out from Saturday's race. After today, the rest of the week is low-stimulus: Wednesday maintenance-light strength, Thursday 4 mi easy + strides, Friday full rest. This session primes the VO2 system without digging a fatigue hole.

H10 reminder: Wear the Polar H10 — double-check "Polar H10 — Connected" in Watch Settings → Bluetooth before you leave. It got left at home for Sunday's long run and we lost the HR data. Don't repeat that four days before a benchmark.

Knee status: Four straight days at 1/5 — fully green-lit. The 10.5 mi long run Sunday at 8:03 avg, yesterday's full hip circuit + PT block, all with zero knee awareness. No modifications needed.

Tonight: Lay out your track kit and the H10 strap. Normal dinner, hydrate well, bed by 10. Set a 5:30 AM alarm — the track is 1.9 mi away, so you want to be out the door by 6:00 to get the activation and warmup jog in before the intervals.
